boundedness_path_disclosure: Literal budget EXHAUSTION (CLAIM_EVALUATION_BUDGET=32 reached, or MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_ROUND/PER_REQUEST reached) is not organically reachable by any known real, non-adversarial query - no representative case in this project's history has produced >=32 factual claims or >=12 tool calls in one round. This validation set therefore verifies boundedness MECHANISMS are active by construction (every request passes through the same unconditional budget-check code path, already proven correct by the deterministic test suites in tests/test_phase9_claim_budget.py, tests/test_phase9_tool_call_budget.py, and tests/test_phase9_pair_batching.py) rather than forcing an artificial, non-representative exhaustion scenario live - consistent with this pass's 'do not overdo live traffic' / 'final confirmation, not another broad benchmark' constraint.

configuration_under_test.source: artifacts/v2/phase9_frozen_config.json, locked immediately before these validation runs execute - this validation run uses the LOCKED candidate, was not used to select it.

tuning_policy: Run frozen candidate ONCE on this set. Do not tune afterward. If a genuine PRODUCT defect is exposed: preserve the failed run, assign a defect ID, root-cause, apply the smallest general fix only if necessary, add a regression test, and explicitly mark this validation candidate reopened - never silently rerun until passing.
